assertions.name: A6_framing_is_the_only_separation_dependence
assertions.source: trace is separation-independent (5.6e-16) while admissible framing is not, and is inverted

description: Closes the embedding caveat qou-3s5e left open — whether a subsystem could inherit a fractional twist from a larger ambient braid — and does so more sharply than the caveat was posed. Framing is LOCAL: in a ribbon category the twist is a property of an object and a morphism's framing correction involves only the strands it acts on, so a bond can carry only the twists of B_w for the width w its routing spans, whatever the ambient braid does. Read off the production routing, band_between(i,j) uses generators 3i+2..3j-1 hence strands 3i+2..3j, giving w = 3k-1 exactly for separation k (verified for k=1..6). The available asymmetry by separation is then: k=1 (w=2) NONE; k=2 (w=5) t=4/5, ratio 9; k=3 (w=8) t=1/2, ratio 3; k=4 (w=11) four values giving 13/9, 15/7, 19/3, 21; k=5 (w=14) five values. THE DEUTERON'S BOND IS ADJACENT, w=2, and B_2 offers only t=1, the excluded boundary — and a free two-nucleon system has no wider routing to borrow from. So the two-nucleon impossibility stands for a LOCAL reason ('a two-strand-supported bond cannot carry a twist') which is stronger than qou-3s5e's per-n statement because it survives embedding the pair in anything. AND THE STRUCTURE IS INVERTED: the substrate supplies channel asymmetry to DISTANT bonds and none to adjacent ones, where physics has the nearest-neighbour interaction as the strong one. Since the bond's own trace is separation-independent (no_distance_decay: 5.6e-16 at separation 2, 3.4e-13 at separation 3), the framing is the ONLY thing distinguishing a near bond from a far one in this construction, and it runs backwards.
caveats: 'FRAMING IS LOCAL' IS A READING, NOT A COMPUTATION. It interprets the corpus's (1-h)^(e/2) factor in ribbon-category terms, where the twist is defined per object and a morphism's framing correction involves only its own strands. That is standard, and it is what makes the width argument work — but no ribbon structure is constructed here and the locality is not verified against the corpus's own framing code. A construction that assigned framing non-locally would not be bound by this result.

THIS MEASURES NO BINDING ENERGY. It establishes which twists a bond of a given separation COULD carry, from the routing width and the Coxeter spectrum. Nothing here attaches a twist to a bond in an atom word, recomputes a trace, or claims a value for any isotope. The inversion in A5/A6 is a statement about availability, not about measured interaction strengths.

The width formula w = 3k-1 is specific to the production band routing, which routes strand 3i+2 rightward through everything to strand 3j. A different routing of the same topological bond would span a different width and therefore admit different twists — which is itself notable, since qou-38i9 showed four routings give identical TRACE. Routing-independence of the trace and routing-dependence of the available framing sit together uncomfortably and are not reconciled here.
